scene_description: A woman with long hair stands inside an airport terminal, holding a handbag and standing next to a rolling suitcase. She is looking out a large window at an airplane flying in the sky.

questions.question: What do you see in the sky?
questions.evidence_hint: Look up in the top right corner of the picture.

questions.question: What is the woman doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at where the woman's face and body are pointing.

questions.question: Where is the woman standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big windows and the airplane outside — what kind of place has airplanes?

questions.question: What is next to the woman on the floor?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the floor right next to the woman's feet.

questions.question: What might the woman do next with her suitcase?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at her suitcase and the airplane — people bring suitcases when they travel.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been to an airport or seen an airplane?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you traveled or saw a big plane.
